title: amphilophium gnaphalanthum
intro: Amphilophium gnaphalanthum, commonly known as the "Pineapple Flower", is a flowering plant species in the Bignonaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Amphilophium gnaphalanthum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its potential to protect against cell damage and oxidative stress.
